_comment: Unity MCP servers for PoSoccer. Written by hand on 2026-09-05 because the
MCP for Unity window's 'Configure All Detected Clients' button cannot work
here: it shells out to a `claude` CLI, and this machine runs Claude Code as
the VSCode extension, which installs no such binary. Its 'Claude CLI Path:
Not found' is therefore permanent, not a misconfiguration to chase.
PORTS ARE ASSIGNED, NOT DEFAULTED. Every one of these ships an in-editor
bridge and three of them default to a port another one already wants:
ozankasikci     6400   COLLIDES with coplay and is NOT configurable.
That last one auto-falls back to a free port when 6400 is taken, but its
server has no way to learn the new port, so with coplay running it will
connect to nothing. Run one or the other, not both.
The two `node` entries point into .tooling/, which is gitignored - these
paths are machine-specific and will not resolve on a fresh clone. Re-run
the clone+build steps there before expecting them to work elsewhere.
